models_evaluated: Transformer-based RL model trained with human demonstrations and manually designed rewards
unlisted_practices: Using a retrieval-augmented LLM planner to generate structured long-horizon plans and sparse reward functions for bimanual robots, replacing human demonstrations and manual reward design

screen.reason: The paper describes the technical development and robotic simulation/testing of an LLM-based planner and transformer reinforcement learning framework (TCP-TRL) for bimanual lifecare tasks. It evaluates novel robotic architectures rather than real-world healthcare deployment practices or guardrails.
